milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the TNT and face it to confirm visual discovery. Target is the TNT stack at spawn-relative [5, 0, 3].
Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the jack_o_lantern and face it. Target is the jack_o_lantern stack at spawn-relative [-4, 0, 3].
Uses inventory_has because mining dead_tube_coral_block with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into inventory. The player starts with 0 coral blocks, so min_count=1 confirms successful mining.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a fence means placing fence blocks in the world. A generous box covers the entire scene. min_count=2 ensures the player placed multiple fence segments (not just one accidental click).
